text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HAARETZ
- Palestinian Authority calls for Arab summit to salvage peace process.
- Chief army prosecutor: Israeli post at Tzomet Katif located on Palestinian land.
- Money-changer and brother shot in Tel Aviv; brother died of his wounds.
- Minimum fares set for international calls.
JERUSALEM POST
- Netanyahu: Peace process in danger.
- Report: Army chief Shahak won't seek fourth year.
- TV: Apartments for ultra-Orthodox needy went to those with political ties.
- Levy to decide soon whether to stay.
MAARIV
- "Jewish millionaire Ron Lauder seen as close to Netanyahu met Syrian ambassador in United States."
- Levy aides say the foreign minister will not resign.
- Huge fire nearly erases park in northern Israel.
- Police will investigate Shuafat housing scam.
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Rocks on Mars, gravel in Hebron.
- Army chief: Soldiers on operational activity should not be made to face criminal charges.
- Netanyahu will probably cancel "kitchen cabinet".
